name: Infiltrator (Ophiduan)
body:
–

Benefit: You have had extensive dealings with other humanoid races, and have learned to mimic their mannerisms and body language to ease their fears of your kind. You gain a +1 trait bonus to Bluff and Diplomacy checks against non-ophiduan humanoids, and Sense Motive is always a class skill for you.

Special: Only Ophiduans may take this racial trait.
